meaning: Source difference is at least the existing 0.1 intervention cap before common scaling, and no one source atom carries over half the sum of source-coordinate atom energies. Rule evaluated per recipient/donor pair, not fixed query ID.
selection_history: One simple conjunction chosen after examining previously exposed v7/v8/v11 development effects and source-only feature tables; no threshold sweep in this unit. Not held-out confirmation, semantic concept evidence, or native necessity.
aggregation: Median selected documents within query/target/condition, then median across four dependent targets; retain full query coverage and rejected or unsupported rows. No independent confidence interval.
future_confirmation: Freeze this exact pair rule and existing rank1, source dose0.1, endpoints and comparators before unexposed document evaluation. Report all candidate inputs and selected coverage; do not adapt rule on new evaluation errors.
